summary.text: Bill Weber is a Republican member of the New York State Senate who has represented District 38 since January 2023 and is running for re-election; Ballotpedia lists him as William Weber Jr., on the Republican and Conservative lines.
He is a certified public accountant and former chief financial officer.

paragraphs.text: William Weber Jr. was born in Pearl River, New York, and earned a bachelor's degree from Pace University in 1991, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes work as a certified public accountant and chief financial officer.

He took office in the State Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding Elijah Reichlin-Melnick, and in the 2025 to 2026 session he is ranking member of the Budget and Revenue and the Disabilities committees.
